opts: A full shift on a finite alphabet
The image of an SFT under a factor map (a shift that is a factor of an SFT)
An SFT with exactly one forbidden word
A shift with zero topological entropy
exp: Sofic shifts are precisely the images of SFTs under sliding block codes. They are more general than SFTs but are still 'finitely presented' in a sense. The language of a sofic shift is regular (accepted by a finite automaton).
